Herramienta de diagnóstico de red para g:
A network diagnostics tool for gaming. It measures latency and packet loss to your router and Internet destinations, displays changes in real time, and provides statistics and a diagnosis to help identify connection issues.

You can pause sessions, generate reports, and export text or CSV files.

En TCP se muestran fallos de conexión; n: TCP shows connection failures; these are not packet loss.
La pérdida ya aparece en el salto entre: Loss is already present on the hop between the computer and the router. Possible causes include Wi-Fi signal/interference, the network adapter, cable, or router; this result alone cannot identify which one.
La latencia elevada hacia el router ocur: High latency to the router occurs within the local network. Check Wi-Fi, router load, and the Ethernet link; by itself, it does not point to an ISP problem.
Las respuestas al router varían mucho en: Responses from the router vary considerably between probes, which can feel like brief interruptions. Wi-Fi interference, local congestion, or router load are possible causes.
Los picos repetidos ya están presentes e: Repeated spikes are already present on the first local hop. Compare Ethernet with Wi-Fi and check for traffic or tasks that coincide with those times.
Se observó una respuesta muy lenta aisla: One unusually slow response was observed, but a single maximum does not demonstrate a sustained problem. Compare it with P95, jitter, and the chart.
Al menos el 5% de las respuestas al rout: At least 5% of responses to the router were this slow or slower. This can indicate local variability even when the average is low.
La cola más lenta de las respuestas al r: The slowest tail of responses to the router is delayed. Check how often and when spikes occur before attributing them to a continuous problem.
Hay variación moderada entre respuestas: There is moderate variation between local responses. If it coincides with lag, try Ethernet to distinguish Wi-Fi from other factors.
Algunas sondas al router no respondieron: Some probes to the router did not receive a response. A small amount may be temporary; if it persists, check the signal, cable, and adapter.
Una señal débil puede provocar retransmi: A weak signal can cause retransmissions, variation, and loss on the local network. Move closer to the access point or compare with Ethernet.
Esta es una referencia ICMP a una IP obs: This is an ICMP reference to an IP observed in a TCP connection from the process; it may be an auxiliary service rather than the game server. It cannot establish the game's actual ping.
Las anomalías aparecen en el primer salt: Anomalies appear on the first identified hop beyond your router, which may point to the link or ISP network. The detected route is indicative; consider sharing the log with your ISP.
Los destinos externos no muestran los mi: External targets do not show the same spikes, so the evidence is concentrated on the local segment. ICMP probes may be handled differently from other application traffic.
Dos tipos de sondeo independientes muest: Two independent probe types show anomalies to this target. This strengthens the evidence of route degradation but does not identify the responsible device or provider.
La conexión TCP al puerto 443 tarda o fa: The TCP connection to port 443 is slow or fails even though ICMP is not. This may reflect congestion or TCP connection-establishment issues; this probe does not measure a complete HTTPS session.
La anomalía se ve en ICMP pero no en TCP: The anomaly appears in ICMP but not TCP/443. Some routers and targets limit or prioritize ICMP differently, so this may not affect normal traffic.
Es una demora máxima puntual de ICMP; re: This is a single maximum ICMP delay; check whether it recurs in P95/P99 and also appears in TCP before treating it as a sustained problem.
Una conexión TCP tardó mucho en establec: A TCP connection took a long time to establish in one probe. An isolated maximum is not the latency of every packet in an established connection.
El destino puede bloquear o limitar ICMP: The target may block or limit ICMP. No response does not prove packet loss in a match; this IP is only an approximate reference.
La variación reciente aumentó frente a l: Recent variation increased compared with the first samples. Something may have changed during the session; compare the time with the chart and events.
El promedio reciente empeoró claramente: The recent average is clearly worse than at the start of this session. This comparison indicates a change over time but does not identify its cause.
La repetición con intervalos regulares p: Regularly spaced recurrences may coincide with scheduled tasks, synchronization, background traffic, or Wi-Fi channel changes. Compare timestamps; this cannot confirm a specific cause.
